item.title: Blackmagic PYXIS 12K Recall: Free Sensor Board Upgrade for Early Units
item.description: Blackmagic Design has announced a recall of all early PYXIS 12K cameras manufactured before serial number 14221337. The company is offering a free sensor board upgrade for affected units or a replacement camera.

item.title: How the 2026 Winter Olympics Will Be Broadcast: 800+ Cameras and FPV Drones
item.description: The Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics start today, and Olympic Broadcast Services is deploying a serious amount of cutting edge technology to cover it.

item.title: Why We Chose It: Dream Sequences and Challenges with the Blackmagic PYXIS 12K
item.description: "Beautiful colour and large format, all in a tiny body." Why Cinematographer James Westlake used the Blackmagic PYXIS 12K on independent feature Imagination of a Phoenix.

item.title: Super Bowl LX: 175 Cameras to Capture Every Angle from Kickoff to Final Whistle via Bad Bunny
item.description: Super Bowl LX takes place tonight at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, and from pre game to post match analysis, the match itself and the Bad Bunny halftime show, the sheer amount of camera tech being deployed to capture the event is astonishing.

item.title: Tilta Nucleus Auto Focus Adapter Officially Launched – Sony E-Mount to PL with AF, Pre-Order Starts $269
item.description: Tilta has launched its Nucleus Auto Focus Adapter, bringing Sony phase-detection autofocus to manual PL cinema lenses.

item.title: Astera QuikBeam LED Spotlight | 200W Equivalent, PoE, Swappable Batteries
item.description: Astera has announced QuikBeam, a new 200 W compact LED spotlight addition to its Quik family of focusing fixtures.

item.title: Inside the Edit of Seized: Sundance Documentary Editor Derek Boonstra on Ethics, Structure, and 40 TB of Footage
item.description: Seized has been one of the most talked about movies at Sundance this year. We went inside the edit with the film's editor Derek Boonstra.

item.title: Sony’s Z300 Handheld Camcorder Explained: The Features That Matter in Real-World Production, Part One
item.description: How Sony's new PXW-Z300 handheld XDCAM camcorder has all the features to make it an excellent fit for modern newsgathering and documentary production.

item.title: The FPV Drones Delivering Astonishing 2026 Winter Olympics Pictures
item.description: Cinewhoop FPV drones are reshaping Winter Olympics coverage, delivering immersive, high-speed perspectives that bring viewers closer to athletes than ever before.

item.title: Apple Studio Display 2 Rumors: Mini-LED, 90 Hz Refresh Rate, and 2026 Launch?
item.description: The current Apple Studio Display launched in 2022 and has remained largely unchanged since, despite growing pressure from third-party displays offering better features. The next version appears designed to address several of those shortcomings.
